input.title: Plan page hides the approve button on a narrow phone
input.body:
### What went wrong?

The plan page hides the approve button on a narrow phone.

### What did you expect instead?

The approve button stays above the footer.

### How can someone see it happen?

Open a plan on a 360-pixel-wide screen.
